name: timed
description: Timed episodes: a seeded degradation schedule drops one component level by level from a first cycle drawn in first_drop, and with probability 0.3 a technician replaces one faulty component at a cycle drawn in window. The same seed gives the same hidden start as static.json, so a static and a timed episode of one seed share their start. first_drop ends at 30 so that a component with three recorded drops at interval 10 reaches its worst level by cycle 50 and a work order created then closes, after the longest lead time and repair downtime of the defaults, before the horizon of 60 with one cycle left for finish.
